blocks.text: The Zscaler and LANCOM Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) with the LANCOM platform.
This deployment guide describes the configuration of a VPN connection to the Zscaler cloud. Deploying IPSec allows the use of dynamic WAN addresses on the client side.
